subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Learning club 1 – Lesson 3: Let’s practise! Carroll diagrams
outcomes: Put machines in a Carroll diagram: makes heat / makes movement.
Make your own Carroll diagram to classify jobs.
Give clues to play Guess the job.

tf.s: A hair dryer makes heat and movement.

tf.why: Yes, the stairs move people up and down.
Yes, an oven cooks food with heat.

tf.s: A comedian needs sports equipment to work.
tf.why: A comedian doesn't need music or sports equipment.
Yes, it turns and mixes food.

tf.s: A Carroll diagram for two yes/no questions has four boxes.
We can use a Carroll diagram to classify jobs.
tf.why: Yes, for example outside job / not an outside job.

tf.s: A zookeeper doesn't work with animals.
tf.why: A zookeeper works with animals every day.

tf.s: In a Carroll diagram, a machine that makes heat and movement goes in the 'neither' box.
tf.why: It goes in the box for both heat and movement.

boxes.q: Which is a category in the machines diagram?
boxes.why: The machines are sorted by heat and movement.

boxes.q: Which machine do you use to dry your hair?
boxes.why: A hair dryer blows warm air.
A blender spins to mix food.

boxes.q: Which machine makes movement but not heat?
Clue: You work inside and help people find books. Who?
Which is a yes/no question to sort jobs?
boxes.why: The answer is yes or no.

boxes.q: Which is a good category to classify jobs?
o: works with animals / doesn't work with animals
boxes.why: It gives a clear yes/no question.

boxes.q: Clue: You work outside and grow food. Who?
A Carroll diagram sorts things using …
boxes.why: Each box answers yes or no.

hunt.q: Needs no music or sports kit

mcq.q: What are the two categories in the machines diagram?
mcq.why: The machines are sorted by heat and movement.

mcq.q: Which machine makes both heat and movement?
mcq.why: Hot air moves out of a hair dryer.

mcq.q: Which two categories could classify jobs?
mcq.why: These are yes/no questions about jobs.
An escalator moves but doesn't heat.

mcq.q: Write a clue for Guess the job: a zookeeper.
o: It's an outside job and you work with animals.
It's an inside job and you make bread.
You tell jokes on a stage.

mcq.q: Where does a comedian go in the performers diagram?
o: doesn't need music / doesn't need sports equipment
needs music / doesn't need sports equipment
doesn't need music / needs sports equipment

mcq.q: A footballer needs sports equipment but doesn't need music. Which box?
o: needs sports equipment / doesn't need music
needs music / doesn't need sports equipment
mcq.why: Yes for sports kit, no for music.

mcq.q: Why does a hair dryer go in a different box from a toaster?
o: It makes movement as well as heat.

mcq.q: Which machines go in the same box?
o: a hair dryer and an escalator
mcq.why: Both make movement but not heat.

mcq.q: Your group's job diagram has one box with only one job. What does this tell you?
o: Only that job has those two features.
That job is the best job.
mcq.why: Each box shows a mix of yes/no features.
